tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background. The ground under every screen, top bar and list.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, bottom nav, booking bar, search bar, price pins.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented control track, skeletons, photo placeholders, disabled button fill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-sunken. Also the selected chip and selected pin fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, surface and surface-sunken: facts, captions, helper lines. 4.5:1 or better on all three.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on bg and surface only: unavailable calendar days, preview tags. Never for anything a guest must read to book.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, chips, secondary buttons, slider thumbs, sheet grabber. 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected date, cluster pin, slider fill, progress. Pair with on-brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text and icons on bg, surface and brand-tint: savings lines, active nav icon.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet brand fill: active nav pill, date range, info band, empty-state icon disc. Text on it is brand-ink or ink.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Saffron. Long-stay badge fill only. Pair with on-accent. Never a button.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Saffron as text or icon on bg and surface: rating star, long-stay notes.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet saffron fill behind long-stay notes. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: save
tokens.usage: The saved heart, fill and stroke. An icon colour only (3:1), never text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on bg, surface and danger-tint.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Error and offline banner fill.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill. Pair with on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger-fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal sheets and under the photo counter. White text on it.

tokens.name: scrim-top
tokens.usage: Status-bar protection over photos, so system icons stay legible.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Map base. The map always follows the app theme.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Map water.

tokens.name: map-park
tokens.usage: Map parks.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: Map roads.

tokens.name: photo-wall
tokens.usage: Placeholder art only: wall. Real screens show photography.

tokens.name: photo-floor
tokens.usage: Placeholder art only: floor and lines.

tokens.name: photo-window
tokens.usage: Placeholder art only: window.

tokens.name: photo-object
tokens.usage: Placeholder art only: furniture.

tokens.name: photo-accent
tokens.usage: Placeholder art only: lamp and cushion.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the Explore greeting, empty states.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Screen and sheet titles, the listing title on details.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Top bar title, card group headings.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: The one price a card or the booking bar leads with. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: A calm, light-filled studio two minutes from the canal.
styles.usage: Listing descriptions and long reading text.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text, list rows, buttons at weight 600.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Badges, nav labels, calendar weekdays. The smallest text allowed.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside cards and list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin and section padding. The default.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; gap before a new topic.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top of a full-screen flow.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, segmented control thumb, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, key-fact tiles, snackbar.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Photos, cards, panels, mini map.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, search bar, pins, icon buttons, floating pills.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Selected segment, compact search bar.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Search bar, price pins, floating icon buttons, slider thumbs.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Sheets, the map card, floating toggle, snackbar.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target, both platforms. Smaller visuals get padding up to this.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Default icon.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips, rows and key facts.

tokens.name: bar-top
tokens.usage: Top bar height, below the status-bar inset.

tokens.name: bar-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation height, above the navigation-bar inset.

tokens.name: booking-bar
tokens.usage: Docked booking bar minimum height.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback, chip toggle.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Fades, pin select, top bar turning solid.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Sheet snap, tab switch, price swap.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Card to details container transform, sheet enter.

tokens.name: dur-slower
tokens.usage: Full-screen flow enter. The longest allowed.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Things that move and stay on screen.

tokens.name: ease-emphasized
tokens.usage: Things entering: sheets, details, map card.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving. Exits run at two thirds of the enter duration.
